fixes.finding: prepare() validates request shape but permits a missing exact shirt reference until controller execution; new coverage required an explicit early exact-shirt check.
fixes.change: Reject missing, retired, whitespace-altered and prototype-property shirt IDs in makeRequest(); valid queries remain unchanged.

fixes.finding: Backup restore advances the receiving store local revision, not the exporting store revision.
fixes.change: Compare preserved session, events and source lock plus expected receiving revision. No saved-data implementation change.

fixes.finding: Some inherited shirt records omit mode_policy; the original runtime treats them as tie-capable.
fixes.change: Browser matrix builder uses optional mode_policy lookup. No application/image changes.

packaging_check: Initial count check caught the archived parent PACKAGE_SHA256.json omitted by basename filtering. Final manifest excludes only its own root path; the parent manifest is explicitly hashed.
